title: Existence of a minimum cut
statement: Let $N$ be a network with distinguished single source $x$ and single sink $y$. Then $N$ possesses a minimum cut: there exists a set $S$ of vertices with $x \in S$ and $y \notin S$ whose capacity $\sum_{u \in S}\sum_{v \notin S} c(u,v)$ is least among all sets separating $x$ from $y$ in this way.
hypotheses_covered: N is a network (with disjoint nonempty source and sink sets and distinguished single source x and sink y)
replaced: \textbf{Existence of a minimum cut} (assumed silently by the book).
